text:
elaine: VertexLabs reported a daily delta where their edge gateways dropped plan_id for batched offline uploads. marketplace accepted events but entitlements didn't bind. Need quick mitigation + recon plan.
matt: short-term: mark events with plan_id=NULL as `pending_plan` and route to a backfill worker. Prefer auto-map if device_registry returns single high-confidence plan.
ravi: Billing sees ~32k token-units missing on 2026-04-07. Policy: auto-apply and charge only if confidence >=0.9; 0.6-0.9 -> provisional (no charge) until partner backfill; <0.6 -> hold and notify.
zoe: ops: add ledger lease during reconcile: `ledger.acquire_lease('vertex-backfill', ttl=600)` and metric `vertex.backfill.processed`. Page SRE if signature verification fails >5/hr.
matt: partner asked for an SFTP batch format and webhook for resolutions. Sample webhook we can send after applying mapping:
```
POST /partners/vertexlabs/webhooks/backfill-result
{
  "bundle_id": "vb-20260408-01",
  "event_fingerprint": "sha256:abc123",
  "resolved_plan": "vertex-edge-pro",
  "confidence": 0.94,
  "action": "auto_apply",
  "applied_at": "2026-04-08T03:10:00Z"
}
```
elaine: partner also wants a lightweight SQL to surface affected customers. matt, can you drop one?
matt: SQL (7d):
```
SELECT partner_id, customer_id, count(*) AS pending_events, sum(tokens) AS pending_tokens
FROM partner_usage_events
WHERE plan_id IS NULL
  AND received_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY partner_id, customer_id
ORDER BY pending_tokens DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
ravi: good. I'll cross-ref with ledger and prepare a customer impact file. Also propose a cap: if provisional tokens >5% of day's tokens for a customer, route to finance review.
zoe: feature-flag the backfill worker (`vertex_plan_backfill_v1`) and schedule a staging run. ingest-bot: created job id vb-20260408-01, owner matt, runs staging 2026-04-08T02:30:00Z.
elaine: owners: matt implements worker+webhook (ETA 48h to staging), zoe adds ledger guard+alert (ETA 12h), ravi drafts finance note & customer comms (ETA 12h). I'll coordinate testing with VertexLabs.
elaine: thanks all
